name: Regenerate examples

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  regenerate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: tokf
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Install just
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/casey/just/releases/download/v1.13.0/just-1.13.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv just /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache cargo target
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: cargo test --workspace

      - name: Install cargo-dup
        run: cargo install cargo-dup

      - name: Run DB integration tests
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/tokf
        run: just test-db

      - name: Run E2E tests
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/tokf
        run: just test-e2e

      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Run fmt check
        run: cargo fmt -- --check

      - name: Run dupes
        run: cargo dupes

      - name: Regenerate examples
        run: cargo run --bin tokf-filter -- generate-examples

      - name: Verify no changes
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code
